_note: Extra exploration states for the plan 10 §7 gates and catalog reach: views a learner reaches with the camera rig (walk, look up, the Go to Spur crater button). Module states m1-m5 come from the stepper. The orbit view (m1) is the secondary scene (3 catalog objects), so it is not a main scene. Drawer states (S5 review F12): the notebook, field report, rubric self-check, Apollo comparison, traverse planner and crater results drawers, opened from their Now-card buttons.

extraStates.name: sky-earth
extraStates.label: Look up at Earth from the LM

steps.eval: (() => { const d = window.__TEST__.scene.surface.sky.sunDir; window.__TEST__.lessons.lookToward({ x: d.x, y: Math.max(0.12, d.y * 0.7), z: d.z }, 14, 12, 0.05); })()

extraStates.name: sky-overhead
extraStates.label: Watch the orbiter pass over the site soon after sunrise, the rover driving below

steps.eval: (() => { const d = window.__TEST__.scene.surface.sky.orbiterDirection(0.2); const h = Math.hypot(d.x, d.z) || 1; window.__TEST__.lessons.lookToward({ x: d.x, y: d.y - 0.42, z: d.z }, 22 - d.x / h * 16, 0 - d.z / h * 16, 0.05); })()
